description: This file defines the DefaultTableMapping class in Drupal, responsible for mapping entity fields to database tables, including handling revisions, translations, and dedicated storage tables.

classes.name: DefaultTableMapping
classes.description: Implements table mapping for Drupal entities, managing table names, columns, and storage strategies for entity fields, revisions, and translations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the table mapping with entity type, storage definitions, and optional prefix.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create and initialize a DefaultTableMapping instance based on entity type and storage definitions.

methods.name: getBaseTable
methods.description: Returns the name of the base table for the entity.

methods.name: getRevisionTable
methods.description: Returns the name of the revision table, if applicable.

methods.name: getDataTable
methods.description: Returns the name of the data table for multilingual support.

methods.name: getRevisionDataTable
methods.description: Returns the name of the revision data table.

methods.name: getTableNames
methods.description: Returns all table names used in the mapping.

methods.name: getAllColumns
methods.description: Returns all columns for a specified table, including field and extra columns.

methods.name: getFieldNames
methods.description: Returns the list of field names for a given table.

methods.name: getFieldTableName
methods.description: Determines the table name where a specific field's data is stored.

methods.name: getAllFieldTableNames
methods.description: Returns all table names that contain a specific field.

methods.name: getColumnNames
methods.description: Returns the column names for a given field.

methods.name: getFieldColumnName
methods.description: Generates the column name for a property of a field.

methods.name: setFieldNames
methods.description: Assigns field names to a specific table.

methods.name: getExtraColumns
methods.description: Returns extra columns for a specific table.

methods.name: setExtraColumns
methods.description: Assigns extra columns to a specific table.

methods.name: allowsSharedTableStorage
methods.description: Checks if a field can be stored in shared table storage.

methods.name: requiresDedicatedTableStorage
methods.description: Checks if a field requires dedicated table storage.

methods.name: getDedicatedTableNames
methods.description: Returns all dedicated table names for storage.

methods.name: getReservedColumns
methods.description: Returns columns reserved for internal use, e.g., 'deleted'.

methods.name: getDedicatedDataTableName
methods.description: Generates the name for a dedicated data table for a field.

methods.name: getDedicatedRevisionTableName
methods.description: Generates the name for a dedicated revision table for a field.

methods.name: generateFieldTableName
methods.description: Creates a safe, unique table name for a field, considering length limits and disambiguation.
